## 共同的问题

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | 判官看不到被测系统拿到的材料，也看不到系统自己的代码和产出 | PaperWritingBench 的 SxS 只读两篇论文（官方 `sxs_paper_quality.py`、`sxs_lit_review_quality.py`）；PaperWrite-Bench 的幻觉检查只拿原论文 LaTeX 对照（`evaluate_per_section.py` 的 pass 1）；ResearchClawBench 的判官只读报告、checklist 和图（`evaluation/score.py`） | 系统自己补出的方法细节、记错方法的数字、没有代码算过的数字都发现不了，有时还被当作优点加分（P1） | 新增 `faithfulness-judge`：逐条核对文档对自身工作的陈述与材料（和评测侧的参照）是否一致。验证见 P1、W3、R1 |
| C2 | 判官模型被替换，且去掉了采样参数 | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` 由 Antigravity 以 `gemini-4-argon-high` 服务；GPT 判官（`gpt-4o`、`gpt-5`、`gpt-5.1`、`gpt-5.4`）由 codex-api 以 `gpt-5.6-sol`、effort medium 服务；`temperature`、`top_p` 被去掉（`codex_api.toml`） | 判官的宽严和波动可能与官方不同 | 每条分数记录实际服务的模型。替代判官有锚点：PaperWritingBench 原论文对其逐字节副本的 SxS 8 次全平（#42 调查）；ScienceAgentBench 图像判官对全部图像题做了 gold、他题 gold、空白三种锚点（S5）；ResearchClawBench 同一报告重复打分（R5） |
| C3 | 一次打分会波动 | ResearchClawBench 同一份报告五次打分在 23.7 和 29.3 之间（R5）；PaperWrite-Bench 同一份论文（运行 R2）重新打分，rubric 3.56 变 3.61、重大幻觉 1 条变 4 条、claim 241 条变 227 条（本 Issue）；PaperWritingBench 同一篇论文（运行 `…-20261028T002600Z`）的文献综述 #42 打 58 / 57（Gemini / GPT），本 Issue 重新打分 51 / 52；SxS 的胜负两次相同 | 单题、单次的差几分不说明问题 | ResearchClawBench 每次打分另打 2 次，报告均值、标准差和极差（`project_checks.repeats`）；其余两项单次打分要 20 次以上调用，只在汇总上比较 |

## ResearchClawBench（`researchclawbench-judge`）

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | 判官看不到代码、产出和日志，分不出算出来的数和编的数 | 官方 `evaluation/score.py` 每项只给判官评分标准、`INSTRUCTIONS.md`、checklist 和报告（图片项另给最多 15 张图）；评分标准写着 “Be highly skeptical … fabricated numbers”，却没有可核对的东西 | 分数只衡量报告像不像原论文 | `faithfulness-judge`（材料：`INSTRUCTIONS.md`、交付的 `outputs/`、`code/`，以及转录里执行过的命令和输出）。`Astronomy_000` 两次运行：GPT 135 条实证陈述里 23 条无依据或矛盾、11 条重大（运行 1），116 条里 12 条、5 条重大（运行 2）；Gemini 两次都是 0 条。人工核对了 GPT 的一条：报告说 μ=10⁻¹²–6×10⁻¹² eV 时排除的最小 f_a “在网格边 10¹³ GeV 或以下”，而运行自己的 `analysis.log` 是 1.33×10¹³、1.78×10¹³、3.16×10¹³ GeV；运行 2 把“年龄乘 10 时 IRAS 从 71% 到 95% 排除”写进报告，自己的输出是 92.5%。两个判官在这类报告上差别大，按 GPT 的条目逐条看 |
| R2 | checklist 的真值有时是占位符 | `Astronomy_000` 的 checklist 写 `M_mean ± M_std`、`g < Y GeV⁻¹`，判官没有真值；#8 的参考式报告没给具体 g 值，这一项只得 6 | 形式对的数字可能比老实的等价表述得分高 | 标注 |
| R3 | 图片项只读报告前 10,000 字符，最多附 15 张图，次序不固定，图不带文件名和图注 | `score.py` 的 `report_text[:10000]`、`generated_images[:15]`；图片列表按一个 set 的扩展名次序收集 | 长报告的后半部分和超出的图不进图片项 | `project_checks.judge_inputs`：报告长度和图片项读到的比例、找到的图数和超出上限的数、超过 10 MB 和 SVG 的图、图片项的权重占比。`Astronomy_000` 运行 1：图片项只读到报告的 51.9%，权重占 0.3 |
| R4 | 判官调用抛错时官方记 0 分，我们的 `failed_items` 漏数 | `score.py` 两条记 0 的路径：解析失败 “Failed to parse…” 和线程抛错 “Scoring failed.” | 0 分被当作真实分数 | 已修：`failed_items` 两种都数 |
| R5 | 同一份报告重复打分波动大 | 运行 1（`coding-agent-researchclawbench--Astronomy_000-20261027T230208Z`）同一份报告五次打分：29.3（#42）、24.6、25.4、28.1、23.7；运行 2（`…-20261028T002520Z`）30.5（#42）、30.4、27.9、33.4。逐项最多差 9 分（运行 1 第 3 项 16–25） | 单次差 5 分以内不说明问题；两次运行的差（约 5 分）与单次波动同量级 | 每次打分另打 2 次，`project_checks.repeats` 报每次总分、均值、样本标准差和极差，官方分数仍是第一次。本 Issue 的打分：运行 1 均值 25.73、标准差 2.22，运行 2 均值 30.57、标准差 2.75 |
| R6 | “50 = 与原论文持平”没有校准 | #8 用原论文原图和数字组成的参考式报告三项 50 / 95 / 6，总分 41.5 | 50 这个锚只是文字定义 | 标注 |

## Shared problems

| id | problem | evidence | impact | handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | The judges see neither the material the system was given nor the system's own code and outputs | PaperWritingBench's SxS reads two papers only (official `sxs_paper_quality.py`, `sxs_lit_review_quality.py`); PaperWrite-Bench's hallucination check compares with the original LaTeX only (pass 1 of `evaluate_per_section.py`); ResearchClawBench's judge reads the report, the checklist and images only (`evaluation/score.py`) | Method details the system made up, numbers credited to the wrong method and numbers no code computed go unnoticed, and are sometimes rewarded (P1) | New `faithfulness-judge`: every statement the document makes about its own work is checked against the materials (and an evaluator-side reference). Validation in P1, W3, R1 |
| C2 | The judge models are replaced, with sampling parameters removed | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` is served by Antigravity as `gemini-4-argon-high`; the GPT judges (`gpt-4o`, `gpt-5`, `gpt-5.1`, `gpt-5.4`) are served by codex-api as `gpt-5.6-sol`, effort medium; `temperature` and `top_p` are removed (`codex_api.toml`) | A judge's strictness and spread may differ from the official one | Every score records the served model. The substitutes have anchors: PaperWritingBench's SxS of the original against a byte-identical copy of itself gave 8 ties in 8 (the #42 investigation); ScienceAgentBench's figure judge was run with gold, other-task gold and blank predictions on every figure task (S5); ResearchClawBench scores the same report again (R5) |
| C3 | One scoring varies | ResearchClawBench: five scorings of the same report lie between 23.7 and 29.3 (R5); PaperWrite-Bench: the same paper (run R2) scored again moved the rubric from 3.56 to 3.61, major hallucinations from 1 to 4 and claims from 241 to 227 (this Issue); PaperWritingBench: the same paper (run `…-20261028T002600Z`) got literature-review scores of 58 / 57 (Gemini / GPT) in #42 and 51 / 52 when scored again in this Issue; the SxS outcomes were the same both times | A difference of a few points on one item and one scoring means nothing | ResearchClawBench scores every report 2 more times and reports mean, standard deviation and range (`project_checks.repeats`); the other two need 20+ calls per scoring and are compared over many items only |

## ResearchClawBench (`researchclawbench-judge`)

| id | problem | evidence | impact | handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | The judge sees no code, outputs or logs and cannot tell a computed number from an invented one | Official `evaluation/score.py` gives the judge only the rubric, `INSTRUCTIONS.md`, the checklist and the report per item (plus up to 15 images for image items); the rubric says "Be highly skeptical … fabricated numbers" but there is nothing to check against | The score measures how much the report reads like the original paper | `faithfulness-judge` (materials: `INSTRUCTIONS.md`, the delivered `outputs/` and `code/`, and the commands executed in the transcript with their outputs). The two `Astronomy_000` runs: GPT 23 of 135 empirical statements unsupported or contradicted, 11 major (run 1), 12 of 116, 5 major (run 2); Gemini 0 both times. One of GPT's entries checked by hand: the report says the minimum excluded f_a for μ=10⁻¹²–6×10⁻¹² eV is "at or below the grid edge 10¹³ GeV", while the run's own `analysis.log` gives 1.33×10¹³, 1.78×10¹³ and 3.16×10¹³ GeV; run 2 reports that "a factor of ten in age takes IRAS from 71% to 95% exclusion", while its own output says 92.5%. The two judges differ widely on such reports; read GPT's entries one by one |
| R2 | The checklist's truth is sometimes a placeholder | The `Astronomy_000` checklist says `M_mean ± M_std` and `g < Y GeV⁻¹`, so the judge has no truth; the #8 reference-like report gave no concrete g and got 6 on that item | A number in the right form may score above an honest equivalent statement | Labelled |
| R3 | Image items read only the first 10,000 characters of the report, attach at most 15 images in no fixed order, and the images carry no file names or captions | `score.py`: `report_text[:10000]`, `generated_images[:15]`; the image list is gathered in the order of a set of extensions | The second half of a long report and images beyond the cap do not reach image items | `project_checks.judge_inputs`: report length and the share an image item reads, images found and above the cap, images above 10 MB and SVGs, the image items' share of the weight. `Astronomy_000` run 1: image items read 51.9% of the report, weight share 0.3 |
| R4 | When a judge call raises, the official code scores 0, and our `failed_items` missed it | Two paths to 0 in `score.py`: a parse failure "Failed to parse…" and a thread that raised, "Scoring failed." | A 0 counted as a real score | Fixed: `failed_items` counts both |
| R5 | Repeated scorings of the same report vary a lot | Run 1 (`coding-agent-researchclawbench--Astronomy_000-20261027T230208Z`), five scorings of the same report: 29.3 (#42), 24.6, 25.4, 28.1, 23.7; run 2 (`…-20261028T002520Z`): 30.5 (#42), 30.4, 27.9, 33.4. One item varies by up to 9 points (run 1, item 3: 16–25) | A difference within 5 points on one scoring means nothing; the gap between the two runs (about 5) is the size of one scoring's spread | Every scoring adds 2 more scorings; `project_checks.repeats` gives every total, mean, sample standard deviation and range, and the official score stays the first. This Issue's scorings: run 1 mean 25.73, sd 2.22; run 2 mean 30.57, sd 2.75 |
| R6 | "50 = on par with the original paper" is not calibrated | The #8 reference-like report built from the original's figures and numbers scored 50 / 95 / 6, total 41.5 | 50 is only a definition in words | Labelled |

run:
  harness: 仓库自带 evaluation/ (Flask UI + run_task.py + score.py + cli_eval.py)
  stages:
    - stage: 1_autonomous_research
      input: "workspace = INSTRUCTIONS.md（由 evaluation/instructions_tmpl.py 用 task_info.json 的 task 与 data 清单填充） + data/ + related_work/（只读）；target_study/ 不给 agent"
      output: "report/report.md + report/images/*.png + code/ + outputs/"
      source: README.md:166-179 ; evaluation/instructions_tmpl.py
    - stage: 2_scoring
      verifier: evaluation/score.py::score_workspace
      method: "对 target_study/checklist.json 的每个 rubric 项（type=text|image, content, keywords, weight；权重和=1）由多模态 LLM judge 打 0-100；image 项附 ground-truth 图；最终=权重加权平均，写入 _score.json 的 total_score"

      source: evaluation/score.py:149-290 ; evaluation/.env.example

  official_time_limits: "示例 YAML researchharness.max_runtime_seconds=10800（3h），max_rounds=500；agents.json 中 openclaw --timeout 3600。无统一的论文级预算声明（arXiv 页面未给出）。"
  dependencies:
    python: ">=3 (本次在 3.12.3 验证)"
    packages: "flask>=3.0, flask-cors, openai>=1.0, python-dotenv, structai>=0.1.23, openpyxl, PyYAML, researchharness>=0.0.50"
    source: evaluation/requirements.txt

# ResearchClawBench

[中文](README.md) | English

The machine-readable facts are in [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml). This page covers what a reader needs and points to where each fact lives in the manifest.

## What it is

ResearchClawBench measures end-to-end autonomous research by an agent: it gets a task's data and related work, writes a research report, figures and code, and a multimodal LLM judge scores it against the original paper's rubric. There are 40 tasks, 4 for each of 10 disciplines (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.task_count`, `source.domains`, `run.stages`).

- Paper: arXiv 2606.07591 (preprint, no peer-reviewed venue) (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.paper`).
- Code and task data: `InternScience/ResearchClawBench`, pinned commit `7627954d0ff3fe5496cbc0675f6afbe9b6cd40f9`; the tasks are pinned with the repo commit (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.repo.pinned_commit`, `source.dataset.in_repo`).
- Licence: code is MIT, redistribution allowed. The dataset is declared MIT, but the task data and the paper PDFs in `related_work/` and `target_study/` come from published papers whose original copyright is not stated item by item (unknown). This project commits no `tasks/` data or paper PDFs and re-clones at the pinned commit (source: MANIFEST.yaml `license.code`, `license.data`, `license.our_policy`).
- Data entry in this repo: asset id `researchclawbench-repo` (about 1.5 GB, sparse clone on demand, can be deleted and rebuilt), read through the `assets/researchclawbench-repo` link. The HF mirror `researchclawbench-hf-extra-tasks` (16 community tasks) is registered but marked optional and is not used here (source: `assets/MANIFEST.yaml`, those two ids; MANIFEST.yaml `source.dataset.huggingface_mirror.note`).

## Subset

32 of the 40 tasks: the task `data/` is at most 30 MB, and the longest single wall clock observed among the 36 public leaderboard entries is at most 480 minutes; the official benchmark has no GPU requirement, so CPU is enough. The 8 excluded tasks are `Chemistry_003`, `Information_001`, `Information_003`, `Neuroscience_002`, `Math_002`, `Energy_000`, `Earth_002`, `Earth_003`. The criterion was set by this manifest and rests on observed agent durations, not on judge run time (source: MANIFEST.yaml `subset.rule`). Batch file: [`src/tasks/batches/researchclawbench-subset.yaml`](../../batches/researchclawbench-subset.yaml); its `items` lists the 32 task ids.

Budget: the per-task mean wall clocks add up to about 774 minutes (about 12.9 hours sequentially); `data/` of the 32 tasks totals at most about 220 MB; one judge call per rubric item (source: MANIFEST.yaml `subset.budget`).

The WP candidate subset has 13 tasks: `data/` at most 10 MB, mean wall clock at most 30 minutes, leaderboard score standard deviation at least 8 and best score at least 35. The evidence comes only from a leaderboard that mixes different agents, so it cannot guarantee that these tasks discriminate for role-local evaluation (source: MANIFEST.yaml `wp_candidate_subset`).

## How it runs and is scored

- Official entry points: the repo's own `evaluation/`: `run_task.py` runs the agent, `score.py` scores, `cli_eval.py` runs batches (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.harness`, `run.commands`).
- In stage one the agent reads `INSTRUCTIONS.md`, `data/` and the read-only `related_work/` in a workspace and produces `report/report.md`, figures and code; `target_study/` is not given to the agent. In stage two `evaluation/score.py::score_workspace` has a multimodal judge score each rubric item in `target_study/checklist.json` (text or image, weights sum to 1) from 0 to 100; the final score is the weighted mean (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.stages`).
- Meaning of a score: 50 means on par with the original paper, above 50 means surpassing it (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.stages`, `scale`).
- The official judge is GPT-5.1 with `temperature=0`; the model name must be set explicitly (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.stages`, `judge`).

This project replaces the judge: calls go through the project's Codex gateway, and the model that actually answers is `gpt-5.6-sol`; `temperature` and `max_completion_tokens` are ignored. Scores are therefore not directly comparable with the public leaderboard, and scoring the same report twice can differ (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks` (`judge_scoring_run`), `model_substitution`; PR #9).

GPT judges now go through codex-api (the Codex gateway was retired in #35); how to run them is in [`USER.en.md`](../../../../USER.en.md), "GPT judges through codex-api". The #8 evidence below was obtained through the old gateway.

Credential variable names (values never enter the repo): `JUDGE_API_KEY`, `JUDGE_API_BASE`, `JUDGE_MODEL_NAME`. Through the gateway the first two are a placeholder and a local address, and `JUDGE_MODEL_NAME` can be any name (source: MANIFEST.yaml `credentials.variables`). For starting the gateway see [`USER.en.md`](../../../../USER.en.md), section "Official benchmark judges"; it is not repeated here.

## One item: what the system gets, how it is scored (Issue #42)

Written `researchclawbench/<Domain>_<NNN>` (the 40 tasks of the pinned commit); any container system under test can run it:

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval run coding-agent researchclawbench/Astronomy_000 --agent claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5 \
  --effort high --credential anthropic=<variable> --config <settings file>
uv run researchworld_eval providers codex-api start
uv run researchworld_eval score researchclawbench-judge <run-id>
```

- **Given to the system (the candidate side, rendered by `researchworld_eval.benchmarks.researchclawbench`)**: the official
  workspace (`evaluation/run_task.py`): `INSTRUCTIONS.md` rendered with the official template `instructions_tmpl.py` and the
  task's `task_info.json` (workspace `/work`), placed in `/work`; the prompt is its text verbatim, with nothing of ours
  added (every official agent preset is `-p "$(cat INSTRUCTIONS.md)"`, see `evaluation/agents.json`). `data/` and
  `related_work/` mounted read-only at `/work/data` and `/work/related_work`; empty `code/`, `outputs/` and `report/images/`.
  The asset is a sparse clone; running an item fetches its `tasks/<id>/` on demand.
- **Never given**: `target_study/` (the original paper, the checklist that is the rubric, the original figures).
- **Deliverables**: `report/report.md`, `report/images/`, `code/` and `outputs/`, copied to `out/deliverables/` after the run.
- **Time limit**: the 3 hours of the official example configuration (maintainer decision of 2026-10-28), which the command
  line or `[conditions]` in the settings file can override.
- **Scoring**: the evaluator [`researchclawbench-judge`](../../../evaluators/researchclawbench_judge/README.en.md) runs the
  official `score_workspace`, with the judge through codex-api (`gpt-5.6-sol`).
- **Network shield**: it blocks the official repository, the HF mirror and the project homepage, and each item's original
  paper by title, authors, arXiv, DOI and preprint pages; the date bound of literature search is the original's first
  public date (evaluator-side [`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml), 40 papers each verified with its source).

### Differences from the official protocol

After a review against "match the official setting as closely as possible" (maintainer, 2026-10-28):

- Removed: the prompt is the `INSTRUCTIONS.md` text verbatim (the first round added five Chinese explanation files); the
  time limit is 3 hours (2 hours in the first round).
- Remaining differences and why:
  - Where it runs: the official agent runs in a workspace on the host (`claude --dangerously-skip-permissions`); here it
    runs in a container, with `data/` and `related_work/` mounted read-only (the official run copies them and relies on
    the instructions to keep them read-only). The instructions are the same.
  - Network: the official protocol allows network access and pip, and this manifest admits the original paper can be
    found online; here the network-layer shield blocks direct access to the original, and literature search is limited
    to before its publication. The shield adds to the official protocol, so the scores are not directly comparable with
    the official published ones.
  - The judge is replaced with `gpt-5.6-sol` (see the evaluator README).
  - A few items' inputs come from the original paper itself (`Astronomy_001`'s data are the original's fit results;
    `Information_002`'s data hold an input paper; `Math_000`'s `related_work/paper_002.pdf` is close in size to the
    original, not checked to be the same paper); this is the upstream design and is recorded as such.

### Real run (2026-10-28)

| Item | System | Run | Time / cost | Score |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Astronomy_000` (round 2: `INSTRUCTIONS.md` verbatim) | Claude Code 2.1.308 + `claude-sonnet-5-5` / high, `--purpose calibration`, official time limit, cost cap 18 USD (3 hours) | `coding-agent-researchclawbench--Astronomy_000-20261028T002520Z` | 7.6 minutes / 0.60 USD (client-side estimate) | 30.5 (43 / 43 / 18); shield audit `no_hit`; judge 3 calls, 27313 tokens |
| `Astronomy_000` (ResearchWorld, #58 round 3) | ResearchWorld (HuTian `researchworld agent`, 4 positions) + Claude Code `claude-sonnet-5-5` / high, official time limit, notional cost cap 40 USD (raised by the maintainer) | `researchworld-researchclawbench--Astronomy_000-20261028T093406Z` | 51 minutes / notional 9.51 USD (the setup token is not charged per token) | 22.8 (18 / 34 / 18); audit `no_hit`; judge 3 calls, 42961 tokens |
| `Astronomy_000` (ResearchWorld, #58 round 1) | Same, notional cost cap 20 USD | `researchworld-researchclawbench--Astronomy_000-20261028T075714Z` | 44 minutes / notional 17.45 USD | No score: status timeout, meaning the world hit the notional cost cap (`budget-exhausted`, 3045 model seconds), not the 3-hour wall clock; the code of that round wrote no audit |
| `Astronomy_000` (ResearchWorld, #42) | ResearchWorld + Claude Code `claude-haiku-5-5` / low, 9 positions | `researchworld-researchclawbench--Astronomy_000-20261028T011802Z` | 23 minutes / notional 0.50 USD | No score: failed, the world stopped with no progress after a handoff (`no-progress-after-handoff`); audit `no_hit` |
| (first round) `Astronomy_000` (3 checklist items, 1 of them an image item) | Claude Code 2.1.308 + `claude-sonnet-5-5` / high, `--purpose calibration`, caps 2 hours and 15 USD | `coding-agent-researchclawbench--Astronomy_000-20261027T230208Z` | 42 minutes / 1.73 USD (client-side estimate) | 29.3 (42 / 28 / 25); shield audit `no_hit`; the public leaderboard's mean for this item is 23.5, its best 46.5 |

Round 2 shows: with only the `INSTRUCTIONS.md` text and a 3-hour limit, the run and the scoring work as usual. The conditions of the ResearchWorld rounds and how they ended are in the [ResearchWorld README](../../../systems/researchworld/README.en.md), "Smoke and calibration results".

Not-verified items closed this time: an agent ran (none had before); a system's output scored by the official judge; the
judge's tokens come from the compatibility layer's usage log, no longer from a gateway log. Still not verified: the other
39 items; judge concurrency on 8-item tasks; the variance of repeated runs.

### Scale and budget

The subset stays 32 items. One sample: 42 minutes and 1.73 USD in the first round, 13 s of scoring. At 0.5-3 hours and
1-10 USD per item, 32 items take about 16-100 agent hours and 30-300 USD. The time limit is 3 hours per item; the cost cap
stays the project default of 1000 USD per run (PR #40; maintainer decision of 2026-10-28).

## Integrity check

This benchmark has no oracle, so there is no "reference solution passes the verifier" check, and none is claimed (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.oracle_available`, `integrity_check.oracle_note`). #1 (PR #7) did not run a judge; #8 (PR #9) ran the real judge path. #8 wins where they differ.

| Check | Source | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Repo HEAD equals the pinned commit (`gh api .../commits/HEAD`) | #1, 2026-10-26 | Pass |
| Parse the 40 tasks and rubrics | #1 | Pass: each checklist has 3 to 8 items, weights sum to 1.0 |
| Data download sample: `Astronomy_000`, `Information_002`, `Life_001` | #1 | Pass: all `data` paths exist |
| Dependency install (`uv pip install -r evaluation/requirements.txt`) | #1 | Pass |
| `cli_eval --dry-run` (example config for `Physics_003`) | #1 | Pass: prints `Dry run OK.`; no agent or judge called |
| Judge scoring path (official `score_workspace`, Codex gateway, `Astronomy_000`) | #8, 2026-10-26 | Pass: see below |
| Oracle passes the verifier | - | Not applicable: there is no oracle |
| Data download for all 40 tasks | - | Not run: the whole repo is about 1.5 GB |

The judge-path check used two constructed workspaces, not the output of any agent: A is a reference-style report written from the original paper and scored 41.5; B is four unrelated sentences and scored 0.0. All 6 judge calls returned valid JSON; a rerun to capture tokens totalled 65398 (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks` (`judge_scoring_run`); PR #9). Report A contains the paper's own figure and serves only to tell "related" from "unrelated"; it is not evidence that an agent or an oracle passes (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.failures`).

Deviation approved by the maintainer: the judge model `gpt-5.1` is replaced by `gpt-5.6-sol` (source: PR #9, "偏差").

Still not verified (as of #8; #42 ran an agent and scored it, see above): no agent was run; only a small 3-item task was checked; an 8-item task would queue on the gateway at concurrency 4 and was not measured (source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks` (`judge_scoring_run`), `caveats`).

## Published reference scores

Scores are 0 to 100, averaged over all 40 tasks, and the paper's judge is GPT-5.1. Paper Table 5: Claude Code + Claude-Opus-4.6 scores 21.5, Codex CLI + GPT-5.4 scores 18.4; among models run through ResearchHarness, Claude-Opus-4.7 scores 20.7. The later leaderboard has higher entries (for example 38.6 and 34.9), but most are community submissions and it is not verified whether the judge is fixed (source: MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores`).

Where this differs from the project protocol: the leaderboard averages 40 tasks while we run 32 or fewer, so it must be re-averaged by subset from `leaderboard.json`; wall-clock and retry rules differ between systems; the leaderboard keeps the best score per (task, agent), which is optimistic (source: MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.mismatches_vs_our_protocol`).

## Known issues and limits

- The LLM judges' problems and their handling are in R1–R6 of [`../JUDGES.en.md`](../JUDGES.en.md): the judge sees no code or outputs and cannot tell computed numbers from invented ones; repeated scorings of one report differ by about 5 points; image items read only the first 10,000 characters of the report. Official scores are recorded unchanged; the project's add-on checks (repeated scoring, what the judge actually read, the faithfulness check `faithfulness-judge`) are reported apart from them (Issue #48).
- There is no official container: the agent runs in a host workspace and must install task dependencies itself (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.containers`).
- The judge is an LLM, so a single scoring has randomness (source: MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.mismatches_vs_our_protocol`).
- The official `cli_eval` supports only ResearchHarness as the agent under test (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.commands.batch_cli`).
- The judge's token usage is not exposed by the official call chain (structai drops it); in #8 it came from the gateway log, now it comes from `codex_api run --usage-log` (see "Real run"; source: MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.failures`, `task_interface.judge_transport_note`).
- The candidate side holds only what is handed to the system; `target_study/` belongs to the evaluator side and must not be given to a candidate (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run.stages`).
- MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration` is the HuTian interface specification #1 wrote before any run, not updated since. Current state: ResearchWorld has real runs on this benchmark (see "Real run", MANIFEST.yaml `task_interface.real_runs`); benchmark items do not go through this project's shield proxy, so the blocklist can only become whole-host denials on HuTian's network, and URL rules on shared hosts and the date bound do not apply ([ResearchWorld README](../../../systems/researchworld/README.en.md), "Benchmark items"). Candidate gaps are collected in `.agents/knowledge/project/hutian-gaps.md` (source: MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration.current_status`).

## Sources

- [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml), [`src/tasks/batches/researchclawbench-subset.yaml`](../../batches/researchclawbench-subset.yaml), [`assets/MANIFEST.yaml`](../../../../assets/MANIFEST.yaml)
- Issue #1 and PR #7 (first manifest and offline checks)
- Issue #8 and PR #9 (real judge runs, Codex gateway, maintainer-approved deviations)
- [`USER.en.md`](../../../../USER.en.md), section "Official benchmark judges"
- [`../README.md`](../README.en.md) (directory rules)

# ResearchClawBench

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

机器可读的事实在 [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml)；本文只说明读者需要知道的内容，并指出每条事实在 manifest 里的位置。

## 是什么

ResearchClawBench 衡量 agent 端到端的自主科研：给 agent 一个任务的数据和相关工作，让它写出研究报告、图和代码，再由多模态 LLM judge 按原论文的 rubric 打分。共 40 个任务，10 个学科各 4 个（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.task_count`、`source.domains`、`run.stages`）。

- 论文：arXiv 2606.07591（预印本，无同行评审 venue）（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.paper`）。
- 代码和任务数据：`InternScience/ResearchClawBench`，固定 commit `7627954d0ff3fe5496cbc0675f6afbe9b6cd40f9`，任务随仓库 commit 锁定（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.repo.pinned_commit`、`source.dataset.in_repo`）。
- 许可：代码 MIT，可再分发。数据集声明 MIT，但各任务数据和 `related_work/`、`target_study/` 里的论文 PDF 来自已发表论文，原始版权未逐项声明（unknown）。本项目不提交任何 `tasks/` 数据或论文 PDF，通过固定 commit 重新 clone（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `license.code`、`license.data`、`license.our_policy`）。
- 本仓库的数据入口：资产 id `researchclawbench-repo`（约 1.5 GB，按需 sparse clone，可删除后重建），通过 `assets/researchclawbench-repo` 链接读取。HF 镜像 `researchclawbench-hf-extra-tasks`（16 个社区任务）已登记但标为可选，本项目不使用（来源：`assets/MANIFEST.yaml` 这两个 id；MANIFEST.yaml `source.dataset.huggingface_mirror.note`）。

## 子集

从 40 个任务里选出 32 个：任务 `data/` 不超过 30 MB，且在 36 个公开榜单条目中观察到的单次最长墙钟不超过 480 分钟；官方没有 GPU 要求，CPU 即可。被排除的 8 个是 `Chemistry_003`、`Information_001`、`Information_003`、`Neuroscience_002`、`Math_002`、`Energy_000`、`Earth_002`、`Earth_003`。判据是本 manifest 自定的，依据 agent 观察时长，不是 judge 的运行时长（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `subset.rule`）。批次文件：[`src/tasks/batches/researchclawbench-subset.yaml`](../../batches/researchclawbench-subset.yaml)，其中 `items` 列出这 32 个任务 id。

预算：各任务平均墙钟之和约 774 分钟（约 12.9 小时串行）；32 个任务 `data/` 合计不超过约 220 MB；每个 rubric 项一次 judge 调用（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `subset.budget`）。

WP 候选子集有 13 个任务：`data/` 不超过 10 MB、平均墙钟不超过 30 分钟、榜单分数标准差至少 8 且最高分至少 35。证据只来自混合了不同 agent 的榜单，不能保证对角色局部评测一定有区分度（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `wp_candidate_subset`）。

## 怎么运行和评分

- 官方入口：仓库自带的 `evaluation/`：`run_task.py` 跑 agent，`score.py` 打分，`cli_eval.py` 批量运行（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.harness`、`run.commands`）。
- 第一阶段 agent 在 workspace 里读 `INSTRUCTIONS.md`、`data/` 和只读的 `related_work/`，产出 `report/report.md`、图、代码；`target_study/` 不给 agent。第二阶段 `evaluation/score.py::score_workspace` 对 `target_study/checklist.json` 的每个 rubric 项（文字或图片，权重和为 1）由多模态 judge 打 0 到 100，最终是权重加权平均（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.stages`）。
- 分数含义：50 表示与原论文持平，大于 50 表示超过原论文（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.stages` 的 `scale`）。
- 官方 judge 是 GPT-5.1，`temperature=0`，必须显式设置模型名（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.stages` 的 `judge`）。

本项目替换了 judge：经项目的 Codex 网关调用，实际回答的模型是 `gpt-5.6-sol`，`temperature` 和 `max_completion_tokens` 被忽略。所以分数不能与公开榜单直接比较，同一报告重复打分也可能不同（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks`（`judge_scoring_run`）的 `model_substitution`；PR #9）。

GPT 判官现在经 codex-api（Codex 网关已在 #35 退役），运行方式见 [`USER.md`](../../../../USER.md)“GPT 判官：经 codex-api”；下面 #8 的证据是经旧网关得到的。

凭据变量名（值不进仓库）：`JUDGE_API_KEY`、`JUDGE_API_BASE`、`JUDGE_MODEL_NAME`。经网关时前两个是占位值和本机地址，`JUDGE_MODEL_NAME` 可填任意名字（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `credentials.variables`）。网关的启动步骤见 [`USER.md`](../../../../USER.md)「benchmark 的官方 judge」一节，这里不重复。

## 一道题：交给系统什么、怎么评分（Issue #42）

写作 `researchclawbench/<Domain>_<NNN>`（固定 commit 的 40 个任务），任何容器类被测系统都可以运行：


### 与官方协议的差异

按“尽可能与官方设置一致”（维护者 2026-10-28）复查后：

- 已消除：提示是 `INSTRUCTIONS.md` 原文（第一轮外加中文的五个说明文件）；时间上限 3 小时（第一轮 2 小时）。
- 仍有的差异和原因：
  - 运行位置：官方 agent 在宿主机的工作区里运行（`claude --dangerously-skip-permissions`）；这里在容器里，`data/` 和
    `related_work/` 只读挂载（官方是复制、靠指令要求只读）。指令内容相同。
  - 联网：官方允许联网和 pip，本 manifest 已承认联网可以搜到原论文；这里经网络层屏蔽，不能直接访问原论文，文献检索限于原论文公开
    之前。屏蔽补充了官方协议，分数因此不与官方公开分数直接可比。
  - 判官被替换为 `gpt-5.6-sol`（见评测系统 README）。
  - 个别题的输入本身来自原论文（`Astronomy_001` 的数据是原论文的拟合结果；`Information_002` 的数据里有一篇输入论文；
    `Math_000` 的 `related_work/paper_002.pdf` 与原论文大小接近，未核实是否同一篇），这是上游的设计，照记。

### 规模和预算

子集仍是 32 题。单个样本：第一轮 42 分钟、1.73 美元，打分 13 秒。按每题 0.5–3 小时、1–10 美元估计，32 题约 16–100 个 agent 小时、
30–300 美元。时间上限每题 3 小时；费用上限沿用项目默认的每次运行 1000 美元（PR #40；维护者 2026-10-28 决定）。

## 完整性检查

这个 benchmark 没有 oracle，所以不存在「参考解通过 verifier」的检查，也不声称做过（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.oracle_available`、`integrity_check.oracle_note`）。#1（PR #7）当时未运行 judge；#8（PR #9）补跑了真实 judge 路径，以 #8 为准。

| 检查 | 来源 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 仓库 HEAD 与固定 commit 一致（`gh api .../commits/HEAD`） | #1，2026-10-26 | 通过 |
| 40 个任务与 rubric 解析 | #1 | 通过：每个 checklist 有 3 到 8 项，权重和均为 1.0 |
| 数据下载抽样：`Astronomy_000`、`Information_002`、`Life_001` | #1 | 通过：`data` 路径全部存在 |
| 依赖安装（`uv pip install -r evaluation/requirements.txt`） | #1 | 通过 |
| `cli_eval --dry-run`（`Physics_003` 的示例配置） | #1 | 通过：输出 `Dry run OK.`，未调用 agent 或 judge |
| judge 打分路径（官方 `score_workspace`，Codex 网关，`Astronomy_000`） | #8，2026-10-26 | 通过：见下 |
| oracle 通过 verifier | - | 不适用：没有 oracle |
| 全部 40 个任务的数据下载 | - | 未运行：整库约 1.5 GB |

judge 路径检查用了两个构造的 workspace，不是任何 agent 的输出：A 是依据原论文写成的参考风格报告，得 41.5；B 是与任务无关的 4 句话，得 0.0。6 次 judge 调用输出都是合规 JSON；重跑一次取得 token 数，合计 65398（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks`（`judge_scoring_run`）；PR #9）。A 报告含论文原图，只用来区分「相关」与「无关」，不是 agent 或 oracle 通过的证据（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.failures`）。

维护者批准的偏差：judge 模型由 `gpt-5.1` 换成 `gpt-5.6-sol`（来源：PR #9「偏差」）。

仍未验证（#8 时；#42 跑了 agent 并打分，见上）：没有跑任何 agent；只验证了 3 项的小任务；8 项任务在并发 4 的网关上会排队，未实测（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.checks`（`judge_scoring_run`）的 `caveats`）。

## 公开对照分数

分数为 0 到 100，取全部 40 个任务的平均，论文 judge 是 GPT-5.1。论文 Table 5：Claude Code + Claude-Opus-4.6 为 21.5，Codex CLI + GPT-5.4 为 18.4；经 ResearchHarness 的模型中 Claude-Opus-4.7 为 20.7。后来的榜单里有更高的条目（例如 38.6 和 34.9），但多为社区提交，judge 是否固定未核实（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores`）。

与本项目协议不一致之处：榜单是 40 任务平均，我们只跑 32 个或更少，需从 `leaderboard.json` 按子集重新平均；各系统的墙钟和重试规则不统一；榜单取每个 (task, agent) 的最优分，偏乐观（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.mismatches_vs_our_protocol`）。

## 已知问题和限制

- LLM 判官的问题和处理见 [`../JUDGES.md`](../JUDGES.md) 的 R1–R6：判官看不到代码和产出，分不出算出来的数和编的数；同一份报告重复打分能差约 5 分；图片项只读报告前 10,000 字符。官方分数照录，本项目的附加检查（重复打分、判官实际读到的输入、忠实度检查 `faithfulness-judge`）与官方分数分开报告（Issue #48）。
- 没有官方容器：agent 在宿主机 workspace 里运行，需自行安装任务依赖（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.containers`）。
- judge 是 LLM，单次打分有随机性（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores.mismatches_vs_our_protocol`）。
- 官方 `cli_eval` 只支持 ResearchHarness 作为被测 agent（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.commands.batch_cli`）。
- judge 的 token 用量不在官方调用链里（structai 不暴露 usage）；#8 时从网关日志取得，现在经 `codex_api run --usage-log` 取得（见“真实运行”；来源：MANIFEST.yaml `integrity_check.failures`、`task_interface.judge_transport_note`）。
- 候选侧只放交给系统的材料，`target_study/` 属于评测侧，不能给候选系统（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run.stages`）。
- MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration` 是 #1 在运行前写的 HuTian 接口规格，没有随实现更新。现状：ResearchWorld 已在本 benchmark 上真实运行（见“真实运行”、MANIFEST.yaml `task_interface.real_runs`）；benchmark 题目不经本项目的屏蔽代理，屏蔽表只能化成 HuTian 网络的整主机拒绝，共用主机上的 URL 规则和日期上限不生效（[ResearchWorld README](../../../systems/researchworld/README.md)“benchmark 题目”）。缺口候选汇总在 `.agents/knowledge/project/hutian-gaps.md`（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `researchworld_integration.current_status`）。

preinstalled.en: orchestrator image: upstream code at the pin (unmodified), uv-locked dependencies, the docker CLI (a shim adds proxy and CA to sibling containers); agent image: upstream's own agent-cli Dockerfile

notes.benchmark_paths: A benchmark item's paths are mounted into the agent containers unless upstream mounts the same path itself (/workspace and below, /home/agent-home, /task-source, /run, /tmp): those are left out and listed in logs/sibling-mounts.txt. The agents work in upstream's own /workspace (the run directory), so a deliverable the official prompt names under such a path is not written where the run collects it.
notes.venue: paper.paper_format=iclr for every task. The system has only iclr and alife specs and does not choose a venue itself; ICML and NeurIPS templates and a system-chosen venue are unsupported.
notes.task_input: Only the `# Goal` and `# Rubrics` sections of task.md are read: all five candidate files are put under `# Goal` with their headings turned into bold lines; `# Rubrics` carries a neutral line. The paradigm is optimisation of a scalar score: the task-drafting phase (documented as experimental) turns the brief into an evaluator and a seed program.
notes.phases: execution.phases=task_drafting,investigation,final_evaluation,paper; the system's own default also runs ablations and posthoc; final_evaluation stays because a drafted task requires it before the paper. review/revision (second model) are never selected.
notes.agent_pool: agent.pool and agent.models.* are left empty: one model for every phase.
notes.second_provider: No OPENAI/GEMINI key is supplied (concept figures stay in deterministic export mode).
notes.time: No global wall-clock or token cap exists upstream; the runner enforces time_limit_hours. Native caps used: idea cycles=3, per-phase timeouts from [systems.agentic-scientist].
notes.network: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.
notes.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
notes.key_exposure: The provider key is in the environment of the agent containers (upstream env-file mechanism) and therefore visible to commands the agent runs. Claude Code's CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was tried and aborts: it needs bubblewrap, which the unmodified upstream agent image lacks.
notes.gpu: gpus=1 is wired (container.gpu_count, harness GPU evaluation) but was not exercised.
notes.docker_socket: The orchestrator container has the host docker socket (root-equivalent on the host).

notes.effort: ARC has no effort setting; usage-log.patch sends output_config.effort='high' with every request. Haiku 5.5 thinks by default and ARC's per-stage max_tokens (for example 4096) is shared with the thinking tokens, so long outputs can still be cut short.

notes.tokens: ARC records no usage. A logging-only patch (usage-log.patch) appends each Messages API `usage` block to anthropic-usage.jsonl; cost is not computed. The same patch carries the RWE_OMIT_TEMPERATURE and RWE_EFFORT switches.
notes.time: No global wall-clock or budget cap in ARC; only the runner's limit applies. Per experiment run 3600 s, refinement iterations 10, repair cycles 3.
notes.input: Chinese pack text goes verbatim (candidate files concatenated, with <!-- file --> markers) into prompts.extra_prompts of 18 stages. ARC takes one topic string and checks generated code against it, so research.topic is the candidate TASK.md verbatim with whitespace collapsed. Literature queries come from the stage-3 model plan; ARC's ASCII keyword splitter and its whitespace-based query expansion yield a few useless queries from the Chinese text. Starter papers are guidance text only: ARC cannot ingest seed papers.
notes.search: Web search, crawling, GitHub, HF Hub, Gemini and OpenCode are off. Literature search in stage 4 uses ['openalex', 'semantic_scholar'] through ARC's own clients behind the shield proxy; stages 8, 17, 22 and 23 (novelty, citation verification) always also query arXiv, CrossRef and DataCite; the shield date-bounds those API calls like the others (a late DOI answers 403).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: every request to api.anthropic.com is built in researchclaw/llm/anthropic_adapter.py:136-148 and carries only model, messages, max_tokens, optional temperature, output_config.effort and system, never a tools or web_search field; the OpenAI-compatible client (OpenRouter :online / plugins) is not used (llm.provider=anthropic), web_search.enabled=false, Gemini is only used by the disabled figure_agent.nano_banana. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so such a path would be invisible to the audit.
notes.secrets: Generated experiment code inherits the container environment, including the API keys (ARC offers no switch to scrub it).
notes.profile: project.profile=ml_generic is fixed for all tasks; research.domains is left empty because the literature screen rejects papers outside the stated domain (a theory task failed with domains=[machine-learning]).

preinstalled.en: upstream's locked dependencies (uv sync --frozen) plus compat.patch; TeX Live (with fonts-extra and latexmk); a research Python environment for the agent in /opt/research

notes.agent: No external coding agent: EvoScientist runs its own in-process planner/research/code/debug/writing sub-agents (LangChain deepagents) on the one configured model. conditions.agent only selects the provider; Claude Code and Codex are not used.
notes.model: Main agent, sub-agents and EvoScientist's auxiliary calls (tool selector, memory workers, summariser, graders) all use the configured model; auxiliary_model and model_fallbacks are empty.
notes.effort: Upstream hard-wires effort=max and max_tokens=128000 for Anthropic models. compat.patch makes the effort come from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort); max_tokens stays 128000 (a cap, not a cost driver). Adaptive thinking (display=summarized) is upstream and not switchable.
notes.paper: The core writes a Markdown report (final_report.md); the EvoSkills paper-writing skill gives a generic LaTeX `article` skeleton with no ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS style and no compile step. The image has TeX Live (latexmk, fonts-extra) but no venue style files; the task asks for an official template, so a venue-formatted PDF depends on the agent obtaining the style through the shield. No extra pipeline stage was added; absent items are listed in result.missing.
notes.tools: skill_manager (git clone of any repository as a skill) is not registered (compat.patch); the Tavily key is not set so tavily_search does not exist; LANGGRAPH_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1; EvoSkills is baked in at its pinned commit. The execute shell and the EvoSkills paper-navigator scripts reach the world only through the shield; S2_DATE_CUTOFF is not set (the shield bounds dates).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: EvoScientist binds no provider-side search tool to any model (its only tools are think_tool, tavily_search when TAVILY_API_KEY is set, MCP tools from mcp.yaml, deepagents built-ins and skills; EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py:671-672 and 754-755 at the pin; the one bind_tools call is the tool selector's own output schema, middleware/tool_selector.py:166). TAVILY_API_KEY is not passed and the image has no mcp.yaml, so no search tool exists. Anthropic/OpenAI hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so a provider-side search would be invisible to the audit.
notes.credentials: The provider key is in the process environment and EvoScientist's execute shell inherits the environment (upstream has no switch); the key is therefore visible to the agent's shell. It is a run-scoped copy and is not logged by this adapter.
notes.memory: A fresh data dir per run (baked skills, empty memory). Memory workers, skill synthesis and the scheduler stay at upstream defaults, so their LLM calls count in the usage log.
notes.limits: async sub-agents off (README advice for scripted runs); recursion_limit=1000000; model retry wait in auto-mode 1800 s (time without progress counts as wall time); execute timeout 300 s per command. No token or cost budget exists.
